note.question: How can explainable deep reinforcement learning support customer acquisition?
note.overview: Effective customer acquisition is crucial for digital platforms, with sequential targeting ensuring that marketing messages are both timely and relevant. The proposed deep recurrent Q-network with attention (DRQN-attention) model enhances this process by optimizing long-term rewards and increasing decision-making transparency. Tested with a data set from a digital bank, the DRQN-attention model has proven to enhance clarity in decision making and outperform traditional methods in boosting long-term rewards.
